# Support

This is a community provider, not an official Zoho or HashiCorp product. Support is best effort and has no service-level agreement.

For provider bugs, open an issue with the Terraform version, provider version or commit, operating system, data center, expected behavior and a minimal configuration with secrets removed. Include the diagnostic text only after reviewing it. Do not attach state, saved plans, tokens or full API responses.

For account billing, service availability, account permissions or API restrictions, contact Zoho support. For sensitive provider vulnerabilities, follow [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).

Implemented capabilities and live-validation limits are documented in [API_COVERAGE.md](../API_COVERAGE.md). Registry installation is not available until a release is explicitly announced. Requests for new resources need evidence of a supported management API and a testable lifecycle.
